_comment: Tier-2: DamHydroConditionLoadProcess only SETS nodal POSITIVE_FACE_PRESSURE; nothing applies it as a force unless load conditions exist, and DamApplication registers no 2D pressure condition of its own — use SMA's LineLoadCondition2D2N on the wet face. Pitfall (kratos.dam #2). Executed on Kratos 10.4.3 (pip wheels, glibc-2.31 host, fresh venv on external ext4 image). LineLoadCondition2D2N constructs; the Dam-flavoured spellings a reader might guess (DamLineLoadCondition2D2N, HydroLineLoadCondition2D2N) are not registered, confirming that the condition has to come from StructuralMechanics. The fixture imports KratosMultiphysics at module scope; with Kratos absent the import raises, the process exits non-zero and the runner records a failure, never a pass.
